course.title: L63 Building, Connection, and Map Details
course.description: 用地图、页面、路、水、书和记录说明建筑、条件、连接、封面、水流、曲线、度数、细节、方向和距离。 场景：学员看地图和页面：建筑、路、河流、书封面、细节、方向和距离都在同一张图上。 目标词：building, condition, connection, cover, current, curve, degree, detail, direction, distance。核心句型：The ... is near ... / I see ... / The ... is in ... / The ... has ... / There is ... / ... is/are ... / statement / The ... is on ...。
